description: The most expensive thing in your funnel isn't your ad spend. It's the steps nobody ever questioned. Required means legal, operational, or customer-driven. Everything else is noise you've been paying to maintain. Go audit your funnel like Tesla audited theirs. #FunnelStrategy #MarketingROI #ConversionOptimization #GrowthMarketing
transcript: Tesla went from 2 billion to 20 billion in revenue in under 30 months. A huge piece of that was just removing what was never supposed to be there. And here's the thing. It wasn't just their checkout. Every layer of their funnel had the same problem, and so does yours. You need to ask yourself one question. Is this step actually required or did we just inherit it? Required means three things, legally required, operationally required, or the customer specifically asked for it. Inherited means someone added it and nobody ever had the nerve to take it out.
